## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible effect.

## Privacy/security impact

- [ ] No privacy-boundary impact
- [ ] Policy schema or rule behavior changed
- [ ] New public surface/sink added
- [ ] New exception added or changed
- [ ] Vela/zkVerify adapter behavior changed
- [ ] Security-sensitive CI/release/dependency change

Explain the classification, affected policy assets, and review required:

## Evidence

- [ ] Unit tests updated
- [ ] Positive fixture added/updated
- [ ] Safe or allowed-disclosure fixture added/updated
- [ ] Coverage-gap fixture added/updated where relevant
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] No secrets, production traces, or user data included

## Checklist

- [ ] Claims distinguish implemented behavior from design/proposal.
- [ ] Exceptions have reason, owner, approver, issue, and expiry.
- [ ] I read the threat-model consequences for this change.
